name: r3-q3-auth-rows
description: Fix round Q3 (S1): probes for dispatch-inventory rows no earlier scenario covered. A signed null-payload token on the device claim (verifyBearer reads payload.userId outside its try: 500 TypeError before any ChirpStack call); a zone create whose timezone, or the stored gateway timezone it falls back to, holds a NUL (post-zone-auth splices it: the INSERT fails); and valve schedule POSTs on valves whose stored owner is TEXT or BLOB, compared as Number(owner). Record legacy and --scoped.

steps.sql: INSERT INTO app_settings(key,value) VALUES('gateway_timezone','Europe/Zurich' || char(0) || 'x') ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value=excluded.value
steps.why: The zone create falls back to the stored gateway timezone when the body has none.
